title: Title Before Tale · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Title Before Tale · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner writes a short invented story title. The lead tells a short story that fits that title. The group can explain how the story fits the title. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Title Before Tale, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group can explain how the story fits the title.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group can explain how the story fits the title.
